Lavosh Roll
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, January 4, 2010 - 11:30pm

Ingredients




1 15" presoftened lavosh -or-
2 10" flour tortillas -or-
2 10" Mountain Bread
4 ounces Soft-style cream cheese with chives and 1/4 cup Chopped, drained marinated artichoke hearts
2 tablespoons Diced pimiento
1 teaspoon Dried oregano, crushed
6 ounces Thinly sliced prosciutto or ham
4 ounces Sliced provolone cheese
1 lrg Romaine lettuce leaf, rib removed

Preparation

1 In a bowl stir together cream cheese, artichoke, pimiento and oregarno. 2 Place lavosh on a piece of wax paper. Spread cream cheese filling over the whole lavosh - right to the edges. Arrange proscuitto or hame over cream cheese. Spread sheese slices in the center. Place lettue leaf along one side of the cheese. Roll from lettuce edge, using the wax paper to lift and roll the bread like a jelly roll. (If using tortillas or mountain bread, divide cream cream mixture and remaining ingredients between the two.) 3 Cover and chill, seam side down, for 2 to 24 hours. Cut roll into 1" thick slices. 4 Serves 6.
